commands.update:
claude plugin marketplace update {marketplace}
claude plugin update {plugin}@{marketplace} --scope project
commands.rollback:
# 1. Leave the latest channel
claude plugin uninstall {plugin}@{marketplace} --scope project
claude plugin marketplace remove {marketplace}

# 2. Install from stable
claude plugin marketplace add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/main/channels/stable/marketplace.json --scope project
claude plugin install {plugin}@{marketplace}-stable --scope project

# 3. Load it and check the version
#    /reload-plugins (or a new session), then:
claude plugin list --json

guide.title: Getting started
guide.lead: Add the marketplace, install a plugin, keep it up to date, and roll back when you need to.
guide.installText: Install any plugin by name. Each plugin page shows its exact command.
guide.installReload: Then reload plugins, or start a new session:
guide.updateText: Refresh the marketplace, then update the plugin:
guide.updateCheck: Then run /reload-plugins or start a new session. To see the installed versions:
guide.autoText: Auto-update is off by default for third-party marketplaces. Turn it on in either place:
guide.autoSetting: In your settings: set "autoUpdate": true on this marketplace's extraKnownMarketplaces entry.
guide.versionsText: Each plugin is versioned on its own with semantic versioning. Claude Code detects an update by comparing the version in the plugin's manifest.
guide.tagsText: Every release is tagged <plugin>--v<version>, and dependency ranges resolve against those tags. A published tag never moves and is never deleted; a bad release is fixed forward.
guide.rollbackText: There is no rollback command. Rolling back means moving to the stable channel, {marketplace}-stable, which serves pinned release tags:
guide.rollbackReturn: Return to the latest channel the same way in reverse, once the fix is released.
guide.rollbackData: These plugins keep their working files (specs, plans, insights, retro ledger) in your repository, not in plugin data, so a rollback loses nothing.
